// Small opt-in compatibility addition for MyGo 9c69cf829ece196c5b3a3601f1c7bbe70526376f.
package ui

// AnchorCaret returns live rune offsets, including navigation queued before
// this key. It is valid only inside this TextKey's OnTextKey callback.
func (k TextKey) AnchorCaret() (anchor, caret int) {
	ed := k.valid()
	return ed.anchor, ed.caret
}

// Composing reports live marked input. Completion must not consume IME text.
// It is valid only inside this TextKey's OnTextKey callback.
func (k TextKey) Composing() bool { return k.valid().compose != "" }

// ReplaceRange replaces rune offsets [start,end) as a separate undoable edit,
// and puts the caret after the replacement. Unlike SetText, this does not
// coalesce the replacement with preceding typing or discard indexed history.
// It refuses read-only inputs and active IME composition. Offsets are clamped
// to the current text. It is valid only in this key's OnTextKey callback.
func (k TextKey) ReplaceRange(start, end int, text string) bool {
	return k.valid().replaceRangeStep(start, end, text)
}

// ReplaceTextRange is ReplaceRange's build-scoped counterpart for a completion
// selected with the pointer. A stale/noneditable/disabled Element is a no-op.
func (e Element) ReplaceTextRange(start, end int, text string) bool {
	n := e.node()
	if n == nil || n.st.editor == nil || n.flags&flagEditable == 0 || n.disabled() {
		return false
	}
	return n.st.editor.replaceRangeStep(start, end, text)
}

func (ed *editor) replaceRangeStep(start, end int, text string) bool {
	if ed.readOnly || ed.compose != "" {
		return false
	}
	start = min(max(start, 0), ed.buf.n)
	end = min(max(end, start), ed.buf.n)
	ed.record(false)
	ed.replace(start, end, text)
	ed.coalesce, ed.hasDesired, ed.compositionActive = false, false, false
	if ed.area != nil {
		ed.area.reveal = true
	}
	if ed.client != nil {
		ed.client.publish()
		if st := ed.client.state(); st != nil {
			st.markChanged()
		}
		ed.client.rt.consumed = true
		ed.client.rt.requestFrame()
	}
	if ed.value != nil {
		*ed.value = ed.String()
		ed.nativeDirty, ed.nativeValue = false, ""
	}
	return true
}
